scope: Retrospective zero-trading-cost application of equation 11, Figure 1 and Table 2 to frozen LiMT US forecasts. This is not a replication of the paper's Portfolio-ML learner or its nonzero-cost implementable frontier.
known_prior_results: Base 2017-2025 returns and yearly results have already been inspected. This plan is frozen before new rank portfolios and utility tests, not before all test-set inspection.
ensemble: Average all three frozen score vectors before portfolio construction; individual seeds are diagnostics, not independent observations or selection candidates.

portfolios.equal: Existing dynamic US500 top/bottom deciles, +50%/-50% NAV; reuse the unchanged execution engine.
portfolios.rank: Average-tie cross-sectional ranks minus (N+1)/2, separately normalized positive/negative weights to +50%/-50% NAV. Daily adaptation of Rank-ML at half the paper's 200% gross exposure.
portfolios.apo: Existing capacity-constrained equal-dollar APO with USD1bn per side budget and 2% caps; retain cash and report actual gross.

timing: Frozen signal at t, execution t+1 close, CRSP total payoff t+2; drift with CRSP price returns and account for dividends and terminal outcomes. No contemporaneous-close fill.
utility: U_gamma = 252*(mean(r) - gamma/2*mean((r-mean(r))**2)); population divisor matches equation 11. U is an empirical risk penalty, not a realized investable return. gamma=0 is the gross mean endpoint.

inference.bootstrap: 5000 paired circular block resamples, blocks 20 and 60; re-estimate mean and variance within every draw

paired_comparisons: LiMT minus LightGBM on identical dates for equal and rank constructions, gamma 0 and 10. No inference from unequal-date or unequal-sampling-unit comparisons.
factor_diagnostics: CAPM and FF5+momentum on each portfolio/window, HAC20. Zero-net long/short P&L is regressed directly on excess-return factors; do not subtract risk-free return again. Ex post alpha and beta are diagnostics, not an ex ante beta hedge.
multiplicity: One Holm family of 5 cases*3 windows*6 gamma endpoints + 2 constructions*3 windows*2 paired endpoints + 5 cases*3 windows*2 factor alpha endpoints = 132. Also conservatively append all 21 prior base aggregate hypotheses (including overlaps), total 153. Individual seeds, alternative HAC lags, bootstrap intervals, missing-return stresses and descriptive scaled curves are diagnostics.
frontier: Descriptive zero-cost strategy rays only: scale each full-test return stream to ex-post volatility 0%-10% in 1pp steps. This is explicitly ex post, not an executable risk target or a proof of the globally efficient frontier. No test-selected scale is deployed.
validation_scale: Separate diagnostic: fix a constant multiplier at 10% annual volatility / 2015-2016 validation volatility, before application to test. Report actual test risk, return, U10 and implied gross; primary remains 100% gross decile/rank.
missing_payoffs: Preserve missing selected returns as zero in primary; repeat each ensemble with adverse long=-100%, short=+100%, without deleting or reselecting assets.
limitations: Already inspected retrospective sample; no fresh prospective holdout
Current-vintage CRSP, OHLC4 VWAP proxy, assumed short availability and ideal closes
Dollar neutrality is not beta neutrality
Monthly 1981-2020 paper design, annual nested refitting, 115 characteristics and Barra-style risk model are not reproduced
Nonzero-cost AUM grid and dynamic cost-aware Portfolio-ML/Static-ML/Multiperiod-ML are outside the requested before-cost test; cannot claim implementability
Existing joint price/volatility ablation is running independently and is excluded from this completed frozen base-model audit
